notes.title: Our new game, Gather, is out now!
notes.content:
Get ready for some farming relaxation, because our new game, Gather is available now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2391910/Gather/

Harvest crops, pick fruit and collect vegetables all while investigating and exploring a series of tiny islands along the way. Discover secrets hidden in the islands while relaxing and gathering a variety of objects along the way. 

Play through over 70 levels spread across 5 different worlds and seasons, each custom built with unique challenges and hidden objects to discover.

Gather was developed as part of Game Develop Month and is intended as a short, relaxing gameplay experience!

notes.title: Scoot Kaboom and The Tomb of Doom is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Fire up your jumping thumbs, because Scoot Kaboom and The Tomb of Doom is available now!

Join Scoot and friends as they tackle the tomb and try to elude the nefarious Dr. Meteora!

Scoot Kaboom and the Tomb of Doom is a fiendishly fun action platformer that all takes place on one enormous screen, that you can zoom out and see all at once at any time. Run, dive and dodge through the twisting maze, evading spikes, saws, fireballs, portals and even more and escape the Tomb of Doom!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It’s time to dive into the tomb! Scoot Kaboom and The Tomb of Doom officially releases on Steam on 1st June 2021!

What started out as a fun idea to make a game take place on one big screen has evolved into an action-filled platformer with over 20 characters to play as and a whole bunch of game modes to conquer and defeat!

Thank you to everyone who’s followed along with the game’s development and we can’t wait for everyone to get to play with Scoot and friends!
